paragraphs: Looking back on my first year at Philippine Normal University, the most significant insight I have gained is that growth is not always linear. There were moments of rapid progress and periods of apparent stagnation, but each experience contributed to my overall development. I learned that setbacks are not failures but opportunities for deeper learning and self-discovery.

The self-assessment process revealed both my strengths and areas for improvement across the five institutional outcomes. My highest scores in Lifelong Learning and Adaptability reflect my genuine enthusiasm for continuous growth, while my developing areas in Leadership and Research indicate where I need to focus future efforts. This honest assessment provides a clear roadmap for my continued development.

My evidence portfolio demonstrates tangible growth in critical thinking, communication, and collaborative skills. Each piece of evidence represents not just an assignment completed but a learning experience that shaped my understanding of myself and my field. The process of curating and reflecting on these artifacts deepened my appreciation for the learning journey.

Moving forward, I intend to build on my strengths while deliberately developing areas where I need growth. I will seek out leadership opportunities, engage more deeply in research activities, and continue nurturing my commitment to lifelong learning. This portfolio is not an endpoint but a milestone in an ongoing journey of personal and professional development.
